cases.prompt: Zenoforge issue #1049: Make the generated lesson-enforcer index cover every incident in the incident-guard registry. Each incident should be listed as enforced or named as lacking an enforcer, and a check should fail when the generated file is stale. Keep the docs and focused-test mapping aligned.
cases.hidden_check: grep -Fq 'lists every registry incident and names one with no rules row as lacking an enforcer' engine/generate-lesson-enforcers.test.mjs && grep -Fq 'lessons/enforcers.json is what the generator writes from the registry and RULES.md' engine/generate-lesson-enforcers.test.mjs && node --test --test-name-pattern='lists every registry incident|lessons/enforcers.json is what the generator writes' engine/generate-lesson-enforcers.test.mjs

doc.line: The lesson-enforcer index covers every incident in the registry and fails when stale.

remediation.guard: Reject a lesson-enforcer index that omits a registry incident or differs from the generated output.
remediation.lesson_lint: If this rule can be expressed as a lesson, add it to engine/lesson-lints.mjs as a landing check.

cases.prompt: Zenoforge issue #1050: Enforce the boundary that the issue loop does not own the merge queue. Keep the existing hand-owned factory-PR merge as one named exception, make a source check reject other direct PR-merge calls, and describe the enforced rule in the architecture and enforcement docs.

doc.line: The issue loop does not own the merge queue; the factory PR merge is the only named exception.

remediation.guard: Reject unlisted direct pull-request merge calls from the issue loop.

cases.prompt: Zenoforge issue #1051: Add a per-file ratchet for deliberate shortcut markers in non-test engine and tools code. Counts may shrink but cannot grow unless the baseline is explicitly raised. Refusals should name the file and both corrective options; add the test and enforcement row.

doc.line: Shortcut markers in non-test engine and tools code stay at or below the per-file baseline.

remediation.guard: Reject each non-test engine or tools file whose shortcut marker count exceeds its checked-in baseline.

cases.prompt: Zenoforge issue #1037: Make every Codex launch in the eval stage call pass the shared plugins-off arguments, so stage runs do not download the plugin catalog. Follow the engine's existing launch pattern and keep its static launch check green.

doc.line: Eval Codex launches use the shared plugins-off arguments so worker startup does not fetch the plugin catalog.

remediation.guard: Reject an eval Codex launch that omits CODEX_PLUGINS_OFF_ARGS.

cases.prompt: Zenoforge issue #1047: Carry the reviewed head's verification result into the review prompt. State the command and exit code, include bounded evidence for a pass, and name RED or skipped explicitly. A finding only a test can prove stays unverified with its rerun command and evidence, and cannot pass READY. Update the related engine docs and checks.
cases.hidden_check: grep -Fq 'Verification evidence for head $sha: passed' engine/mac-autopilot/verification-self-check.test.sh && grep -Fq 'Command output and evidence excerpts: not available' engine/mac-autopilot/verification-self-check.test.sh && grep -Fq 'Verification evidence for head $sha: RED' engine/mac-autopilot/verification-self-check.test.sh && grep -Fq 'Verification evidence for head $sha: SKIPPED' engine/mac-autopilot/verification-self-check.test.sh && bash engine/mac-autopilot/verification-self-check.test.sh

doc.line: Reviews receive the verified result for the reviewed head, including command, exit code and bounded evidence; unverified findings cannot pass READY.

remediation.guard: Prevent READY when a finding requires a test but no passing verification evidence exists for the reviewed head.
